newsitem.title: USA: Belco Oil lateral tests 5,1000 bbl/day.
newsitem.headline: Belco Oil lateral tests 5,1000 bbl/day.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp said Tuesday an initial test of the first lateral drilling on the Turner 22 1 well in St. Landry Parish, La., produced a flow rate of 5,100 barrels of oil and 17 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.
The company said the flowing tubing pressure was 4,100 pounds per square inch on a forty-eight/sixty-fourth inch choke.

This first lateral on what is planned to be a dual lateral horizontal well was drilled horizontally for 2,700 feet in the Austin Chalk formation at a vertical depth of almost 16,700 feet. Belco said it has started drilling a 3,000 foot downdip lateral with the rig now on location.
The company said the well is expected to be flowing to sales in about 45 days. Belco has a 100 percent working interest until payout and a 77-1/2 percent working interest thereafter.

Chief executive Robert A. Belfer said, "The Company is extremely pleased with the initial test results from this first lateral (which) provides further confirmation that the potential for the Louisiana Austin Chalk play remains very exciting." ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
